items.title: Why Even Auto Anymore
items.summary:
After the INSANE NERF they did to Affinity, nerfing Auto is just a spit in the face, punch in the groin, and a slap in the… well a slap there would constitute a lawsuit.

It’s one thing to make Affinity essentially cost a lifetime and your generation’s offspring to complete.

But now adding Insult to Injury to Infinity with the newly added sparkling 16-20 Affinity being the equivalent of RuneScape 95-99 (which is 1-95 5 TIMES) makes it so NO ONE IN THEIR LIFETIME can EVER reach it before the heat death of the universe. Unless you start now that is. Gl hf.

I get it was maybe a little too lenient on giving rewards and hurting the bottom line, but this is just the first nerf of the inevitable down the line to slowly drain the game of its essence for the sake of profit. That’s the curse of popularity I suppose.

I hope you at least reconsider what the term “Affinity” even means.

Because doing (with an average of now 20 based on the current Max Average Affinity w/out Auto)
7500 Battles for Max Affinity 150,000 on ONE AWAKENER.
M A N U A L L Y.

You might as well quit your day job and make this your new one.

I hope you’re happy.

Because if your Awakener wasn’t sick of you fighting the same enemy before.

They will be now.
items.author: Your Irrational Hero
